title: Best Headphones Under $500: First Look
verdict: The Sony WH-1000XM5 delivers the best all-around package with superior ANC and comfort. For pure sound quality, the Sennheiser HD 660S2 edges ahead for critical listening.
testingNotes: Tested across jazz, rock, classical, and podcasts. Measured frequency response and THD. Battery life verified with continuous playback at 60% volume.

faq.q: Do I need an amp for these headphones?
faq.a: Not for wireless models. Wired audiophile models like the Sennheiser HD 660S2 benefit from a dedicated amp but sound good from quality phone/laptop outputs.
Essential for travel and noisy environments. If you primarily listen at home, consider open-back wired models for better soundstage instead.
